newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr edges up vs yen but still seen directionless.
newsitem.headline: Dlr edges up vs yen but still seen directionless.

text.p: 0145 GMT --*Dollar inched up against yen by mid-morning Tokyo but remained within narrow range in directionless trade.
*Dollar upside capped by talk of relatively heavy offers, seen as profit-taking sales, around 118.25 yen for time being, traders said.
*Operators expect little action before Bundesbank's decision on money market rates later Tuesday.
*Expectations of commercial dollar buying at 0100 GMT fixing helped lift greenback versus yen earlier, but dollar rise was checked by selling by U.S. players, traders said.

*"A consensus seems to be building in the market that Buba will continue with a fixed repo when it sets a tender for securities repurchase agreements today. But people are still cautious ahead of the announcement," said a city bank trader.

*Speculation that Buba will raise interest rates was dampened after Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Krupp said on Monday that rise in German interest rates would be "very damaging" to German economy.
0004 GMT --*Dollar steady vs yen in directionless trade, with activity dull ahead of U.S. Fed policy-setting meeting and Bundesbank's decision on money market rates later in day.

*"Today's focus is on whether the dollar will be able to rise above 118.50 yen," said a dealer at a European bank. "But even if it breaks that, the topside could be limited at around 118.70 yen," he said.
*Downside solid due to mark short-covering vs yen in crosses and buying-on-dips demand below 118 yen. Japanese trading companies may be buying dollars, he added.
